Tools to identify vulnerable Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) webapps.

I've built these tools to automate bughunting and pentesting of AEM webapps. I've included checks for previously known vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, as well as for new ones, discovered by me in 2018/2019.
All discovered vulnerabilities were responsibly reported to Adobe PSIRT
You can find more details about vulnerabilities and techniques in presentations, I've prepared for
AEM webapps are widespread and rarely configured securely or kept up to date. Bughunter, you have good chances to find security bugs, enjoy the tools!

- script to discover AEM webapps from list of URLs.
- scripts to get RCE from SSRF.
